profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. describes itself as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform. The company says the platform is meant to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive business outcomes, and it describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader that turns data into decisions and autonomous actions. It is a public company traded under the ticker DT, with CIK 0001773383, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

On AI specifically, the site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 187. No individual cases, tracked products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
